lab.wrong: Almost! Remember: h / s = H / S, so H = h × S ÷ s. Try again.

intro.title: How tall is that building?
intro.body: No ladder, no drone — just the sun! When the sun shines, it hits you and the building at the same angle, so your shadows make triangles with the same shape.

sun.title: Move the sun
sun.body: Use the sun lever on your right. Watch both shadows grow and shrink together — move it at least twice, then press Next.

measureYou.title: Measure YOUR shadow (s)
measureYou.body: Point at the red ring at the tip of your shadow and press the trigger.

measureBuilding.title: Measure the building's shadow (S)
measureBuilding.body: Now point at the ring at the tip of the building's shadow.

triangles.title: Same shape, different size!
triangles.body:
Your triangle: h = {h} m, s = {s} m, so h ÷ s = {ratio}.
The building's triangle has the same shape, so H ÷ S = {ratio} too.
S = {S} m. How tall is the building?

done.title: You found it!
done.body: The building is {H} m tall. You just used similar triangles: H = h × S ÷ s.
